reviewNote: Drafted by Claude from the chart for faculty review. Not validated teaching content.
summary: 85 y with moderate dementia and an activated HCPOA signed her own consent for a cataract; she cannot lie flat (SpO2 89% when the head was lowered) for a procedure that needs her flat and still; DNR/DNI.

asa.rationale: HFrEF EF 35% with orthopnea at rest, CKD 3b, moderate dementia.

decision.rationale: Consent is invalid (patient lacks capacity; daughter is the activated agent). She cannot tolerate the flat position, and GA is excluded by her DNI. Reschedule after consent from the POA and a realistic positioning plan with the surgeon, or reconsider the procedure.

redFlags.finding: Consent signed by a patient who lacks capacity
redFlags.evidence: HCPOA activated 03/2025 by physician determination of incapacity; patient oriented to self; signed 0705; daughter not reached.
redFlags.action: Obtain informed consent from the daughter (POA), by phone if needed with witness.

redFlags.evidence: Sleeps in a recliner; SpO2 89% and dyspneic when HOB lowered; cardiology deferred positioning; ophthalmology H&P template said she can lie flat.
redFlags.implication: Cataract surgery needs a flat, still head for 25 min; sedation would worsen it.
redFlags.action: Do not proceed as booked; surgeon and anesthesia to agree on a semi upright technique or defer.

redFlags.evidence: POLST 03/2025: DNR, selective treatment, no intubation.
redFlags.action: Required reconsideration discussion with the POA before any anesthetic.

redFlags.finding: HFrEF NYHA III with new LBBB and mild to moderate AS
redFlags.implication: Little reserve for sedation, anxiety, or fluid.
redFlags.action: Minimal sedation, avoid hypotension and tachycardia.

redFlags.finding: Dementia with severe hearing loss and agitation risk
redFlags.evidence: MoCA 12, hearing aids refused, agitates when frightened; codeine delirium.
redFlags.action: Large print communication, familiar aide present, avoid benzodiazepines and anticholinergics, minimal titrated sedation.

planItems.item: Standard monitors with capnography; supplemental oxygen
Return to assisted living with clear handoff

boothComplications.why: Sedation in a frail patient breathing spontaneously
